full_name: Min Jin Lee | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Fiction & Poetry Catherine A. and Mary C. Gellert Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Min Jin Lee is currently researching and writing her third novel, which explores the role of education for Koreans around the world for her diaspora trilogy The Koreans, which includes Free Food for Millionaires and Pachinko.
